decisions.reason: The distribution warning refinement does not change the approved assessment-date or page-two copy; those are separate amendments already represented in this Requirement.
Refining the distribution warning does not change which customer fields are editable or the assessment-date field format.

The warning must avoid interfering with the footer, but the existing requirement already mandates a consistent footer on every page. The source warning refinement introduces no new footer-state value or scope change.
The source makes a component-specific refinement to the distribution warning while expressly retaining the overall design direction; it does not change the report-wide visual-theme state.
The final-page distribution warning refinement does not alter internal-page header coverage, content, or presentation.
The source decision concerns the distribution warning on page 4 and does not change the front-page result panel or score presentation.
The warning refinement does not change the content, detail level, or format of the front-page result drivers.
The distribution warning's visual treatment is unrelated to the vehicle identifier and its display format.
The source decision does not change the DX-17 identifier used in internal page headers.
The distribution warning refinement does not alter the scoring-summary table or its required fields.
The warning's page-level visual refinement does not change the required reusable fonts, icons, or design-asset package.
The source decision does not change the recommendation style or priority tiers.
